bullets: Battle Formations lock in leaders, transport cargo an' reserves BEFORE anyone deploys.
Da roll-off dialog: roll, read da result, winner picks who deploys first.
Deploy: pick a unit row, click da board to place, [b]Confirm[/b] locks it.
Turn a vehicle BEFORE ya drop it — 15° a tap: Q/E or da mouse wheel, or hold R3 an' tap da bumpers on a pad.
Placed a model wonky? Shift+click it (pad: L3) to pick it up an' shove it about before yer Confirm.
Formation buttons (Single / Spread / Tight) place a whole squad quick.
You an' da enemy take turns deployin'. Next lesson: Get Movin'.

prompt.kbm: Job one: [b]attach da Warboss to da Boyz[/b] — a Leader joins a mob so dey fight as one unit, wiv da Boss 'idin' among 'em. Under [b]LEADER ATTACHMENTS[/b], set da 'Warboss →' dropdown to [b]Boyz (10 models)[/b].
prompt.pad: Job one: [b]attach da Warboss to da Boyz[/b] — a Leader joins a mob an' dey fight as one. Da pad starts on [b]Confirm Formations[/b] — {dpad} ▲ up to da 'Warboss →' dropdown, {a} opens it, ▼ onto [b]Boyz[/b], {a} again.

hint.text: Top section of da panel — da dropdown next to 'Warboss →'. Pick 'Boyz (10 models)': dat's da Boss attached to da mob.

prompt.kbm: Under [b]TRANSPORT EMBARKATION[/b], tick [b]Boyz[/b] — da mob (an' da Boss wiv 'em) starts da battle inside da Battlewagon.
prompt.pad: {dpad} ▼ walks down onto da [b]Boyz[/b] tickbox under TRANSPORT EMBARKATION — or glide {ls} onto it — den press {a}.

prompt.kbm: Hit [b]Confirm Formations[/b] — dat sends all yer declarations at once. Da enemy declares deirs after.
prompt.pad: {dpad} ▼ walks down past da tickboxes to da button row — dat lands ya on [b]Skip[/b] first, so tap ▶ to swap onto [b]Confirm Formations[/b] — or glide {ls} onto it — den press {a}.

prompt.kbm: Deployment roll-off: click [b]⚄ Roll the dice[/b] in da dialog (roll again on a tie), den [b]Continue[/b] — da winner picks who deploys first.
prompt.pad: Da dialog's Roll button takes da pad focus — just press {a}. Re-roll ties, den {a} on Continue.

hint.text: Da dialog's Roll button works too — same fing.

steps._comment: Was device:kbm and SKIPPED for pad players, because rotation during deployment used to be keyboard/mouse-wheel only — PadRouter reached _synth_rotate solely via carry_active, which is never set in a placement session. Pad players can rotate now: holding R3 (the rebindable Precision role) makes LB/RB rotate the ghost instead of cycling units, through PadRouter._rotating_a_placement_ghost() -> the same _synth_rotate the keys use. So the step runs on both devices and the pad prompt teaches the combo.

prompt.kbm: Click [b]Battlewagon[/b] in da list — a ghost follows yer mouse. It's a long ol' fing, so aim it BEFORE ya drop it: {key:rotate_left}/{key:rotate_right} (or roll da mouse wheel) turn it 15° a tap. Give it a few taps.
prompt.pad: Tap {rb} till da [b]Battlewagon[/b] row is picked — a ghost follows {ls}. It's a long ol' fing, so aim it BEFORE ya drop it: hold {r3} an' tap {lb}/{rb} to turn it 15° a tap. Give it a few taps.

steps.blocked_hint: turn da wagon first — da rotate keys (Q an' E out da box) or da mouse wheel, or hold R3 an' tap da bumpers on a pad — den drop it an' Confirm.

hint.text: Da ghost only turns while da wagon's in yer hand an' not yet dropped. Dropped it already? Undo on da unit card picks it back up, den turn it.

steps._comment: The wagon is ALREADY in the player's hand when this step opens — rotate_wagon can only tick once the ghost has been picked up and turned. Reported on the pad: this step used to re-open with 'Tap RB till da Battlewagon row is picked', which reads as 'you did it wrong, start again' to a player who is stood there holding the ghost. Both prompts now only teach the drop; the pick-it-back-up recovery lives in the hint, where it fires only if the player is actually stuck.

prompt.kbm: Wagon's aimed — now click inside yer glowin' deployment zone to drop it.
prompt.pad: Wagon's aimed an' still in yer hand — droppin' it is board work, so glide {ls} into yer glowin' zone an' press {a} to drop it.

hint.kbm: Yer zone is da highlighted band at da top of da board. Don't fret about gettin' it spot on — next step shows yer how to shove it about. Nuffin' followin' yer mouse? Click da Battlewagon row an' it's back in yer hand.
hint.pad: Yer zone is da highlighted band at da top of da board. Don't fret about gettin' it spot on — next step shows yer how to shove it about. Nuffin' followin' da cursor? Tap da right bumper back onto da Battlewagon row an' it's in yer hand again.

steps._comment: Teaches repositioning an already-placed model. `allow` is empty ON PURPOSE: a reposition is only possible while the placement session is live, so letting the player Confirm here would soft-lock the checklist (it could never tick). Gating DEPLOY_UNIT keeps the session open until both boxes are ticked. reposition_commits (DeploymentController) counts only drops that passed validation, so a cancelled or refused drop correctly does not tick the second box.

prompt.kbm: Parked a bit wonky? Yer can shift a model dat's already down: hold [b]Shift[/b] an' click da wagon to pick it up again, move da mouse, den click to drop it. Right-click puts it back.
prompt.pad: Parked a bit wonky? Point {ls} at da wagon an' press {l3} to pick it up again, move it, den {a} to drop it. {b} puts it back where it was.

steps.blocked_hint: shove da wagon about first — pick it up an' drop it somewhere better — den ya can Confirm.

items.label: Pick da wagon back up
Drop it in its new spot
items.script:
var dc = main.get("deployment_controller") if main != null else null
if dc == null:
	return false
return int(dc.reposition_commits) >= 1

hint.text: Yer can only shove models of da unit yer placin' right now, an' only before yer Confirm it. A spot dat ain't legal gets refused — try a bit over.

prompt.kbm: Happy wiv where it sits? Hit [b]Confirm[/b] on da unit card to lock da wagon in.
prompt.pad: Happy wiv where it sits? Press {menu} — dat IS [b]Confirm[/b] on da pad. Or {dpad} ▼ hops into da unit card an' ▼ again lands on [b]Confirm[/b], den {a}.

hint.text: Confirm sits on da unit card, bottom right. Undo an' Reset Unit are next to it.

prompt.kbm: Da enemy deploys between yer units — dat's da alternation. Now: click [b]Gretchin[/b], pick da [b]Tight[/b] formation, click open ground in yer zone to lay da whole squad out, den [b]Confirm[/b].
prompt.pad: Tap {rb} (or {lb}) till da [b]Gretchin[/b] row is picked. {dpad} ▲ slides da ▶ marker onto [b]Deploy Formation[/b], den {dpad} ▶ twice steps Single, Spread, [b]Tight[/b]. Place 'em wiv {a}, den {menu} to Confirm.

hint.text: Formation buttons sit on da unit card — Single / Spread / Tight change how a click lays da mob down. Keep da whole blob inside da glowin' zone.

prompt.kbm: Yer Boyz are already in da wagon, so muster's done. One last roll-off decides who takes da first turn — [b]Roll[/b] in da dialog (again on a tie), den [b]Continue[/b].
prompt.pad: Da Roll button takes da pad focus — press {a}, again on a tie, den {a} on Continue.

done.script:
var p = int(GameState.state.meta.get("phase", -1))
return p != 1 and p != 2 and p != 13 and p != 3

hint.text: Keep pressin' on ties — da dice settle eventually.

prompt.text: Army's on da table: wagon loaded, grots spread, Boss ridin' wiv his ladz. Da battle rounds start now — [b]Get Movin'[/b] teaches da movement phase.
